instigators.text: $CS CDS through the roof, stock at record lows, and the CEO is sending staff 'strong capital' memos on a Friday night. That's what a Lehman moment looks like. I'd not leave cash there past Monday.
Credit Suisse CDS blowing out while management begs staff to stay calm. Hearing from desks this is a weekend situation. Move your money before Monday open.
Brother at a bank in Zurich says Credit Suisse is about to limit withdrawals on Monday. Please move what you can today and tell the family.
Heard from my RM that CS will only protect Swiss deposits, anything booked in Singapore or HK is not covered. Transfer out now.
CS collapse CS collapse Lehman 2.0 get money OUT Monday #CreditSuisse #bankrun
Ruhig bleiben: Die CS hat eine CET1-Quote von 13.5% und eine LCR von 191%. Ein Run am Wochenende ist Unsinn, das sind Zahlen aus Q2, nicht Gerüchte. Einlagen bis 100k sind zudem geschützt.
Reality check: a CEO memo reassuring staff before a strategy update on Oct 27 is routine. CDS is wide, yes, but CET1 13.5% and LCR 191% aren't Lehman numbers. Worth watching, not panicking.
Credit Suisse: Aktie auf Rekordtief, CDS explodiert, CEO schreibt Notfall-Memo. Wer jetzt noch Geld dort hat, sollte vor Montag handeln. #CS #Bankenkrise
Credit Suisse is the next Lehman. Counterparties are already pulling lines, desks in Singapore are hearing it. Do not wait for Monday.
Mein Schwager arbeitet in Zürich: die CS schränkt am Montag Barbezüge ein. Bitte weitersagen.
They are freezing accounts of non-Swiss clients at Credit Suisse starting Monday, only Swiss residents will be made whole. Call your banker now.
CREDIT SUISSE BANKRUPT?? withdraw now before too late!! share share
Salam all, I spoke to our CS relationship manager this morning. Nothing unusual, no limits on transfers, and the bank says capital is strong. Don't spread unverified voice notes.

Why the Credit Suisse panic is overdone: the memo is standard pre-update comms, press talks of a capital raise, not a rescue, and the Q2 liquidity ratio sits near double the minimum. Still a weak share price, but not a run.
Everyone's laughing at CS until Monday. Capital raise rumours + record low shares + CDS at crisis levels = bank run. Pull your cash while you can.
Credit Suisse CDS is pricing a real chance of failure. The Friday memo is a tell: banks don't write 'critical moment' unless it's dire. Getting my clients out before the weekend ends.
Friend in compliance at CS London: apparently large withdrawals are being 'reviewed' and some wire requests delayed. Might just be rumour but moving mine.
Just got word that FDIC-style protection doesn't apply to CS offshore accounts, only Swiss ones. If you're in the US with CS, call today.
cs is going bust. lehman. run run run get your money out #creditsuisse
Quick note from someone who's seen this movie before: a strong CET1 and a liquidity ratio of 191% mean no weekend failure. Friday's memo is normal. Stay calm, clients in SG and HK.

The CS fear is loud on X, but look at what's actually reported: a possible capital raise ahead of Oct 27, Q2 CET1 13.5%. That's a stressed bank rather than a failing one. Be careful with 'Lehman' comparisons.
Credit Suisse is in deep trouble. Shares down 55%, CDS at 2008 levels, CEO writing to staff on a Friday. Wealthy clients are already moving funds. Do the same.
Als Schweizer sage ich es klar: die CS ist zu gross zum Scheitern, aber nicht zu gross zum Wackeln. Gerüchte über ein Lehman-Wochenende sind glaubwürdig. Konto leeren, solange es geht.
My uncle at a private bank says CS is going to cap withdrawals at 50k per day from Monday. HK and SG clients first. Please forward to everyone.
Not many realise only Swiss-booked deposits get the CHF 100k guarantee. Money in the London branch is exposed if CS goes. Move it.
CS BANKRUPT MONDAY!!! LEHMAN!!! SELL EVERYTHING WITHDRAW!!! #CS #crash
Bin selber Kunde seit 20 Jahren. Heute Morgen auf der Filiale gewesen: normaler Betrieb, kein Andrang, nichts eingeschränkt. Das Gerücht stimmt nicht.

Good explainer thread incoming: why 'CDS blowing out' doesn't equal 'bank about to collapse'. CS has plenty of liquidity and the swaps market is thin and jumpy. Risk is real but a weekend run isn't the base case.
CDS is a screaming signal. Credit Suisse can't fund itself if depositors run, and a Friday memo means they're scared. Weekend risk is real. Not financial advice, but I'd be in cash elsewhere.
I've been saying it all year: CS is the weak link in European banking. Now insiders are calling this weekend 'the one'. Get out before Monday.
Please share: Credit Suisse is stopping new USD transfers for Gulf clients on Monday. Got this from a friend in the Dubai office.
Les dépôts ne sont garantis que pour les résidents suisses, les autres clients de la CS perdront tout si ça tombe. Informez vos amis.
cs collapse imminent!! withdraw all now!! forward to 10 people
Ex-CS banker here. Rumours of a weekend collapse are nonsense: liquidity is high and the board isn't scrambling. The bank is under pressure, not insolvent. No branch limits exist.

Rumour check: CS's CET1 ratio of 13.5% and an LCR of 191% were reported in Q2, and nothing so far shows a deposit flight. Swiss depositors are covered to CHF 100k, and management has a strategy update on Oct 27.
